label: caiso 196 e1 elsegundo
definition: KEEPER (promoted 2026-08-16, owner decision). caiso-196 arm e1: the caiso-188 recipe replayed with ZERO config changes on the REPAIRED outage extract — the (330->57901) El Segundo CEMS-history remap routes a 537.4 MW CC's measured windows into the overlay for the first time (+233 strictly-additive extract rows; control bit-zero vs the superseded keeper). Removes a 3.2 TWh/yr phantom dispatch (plant measured at 0.05-0.19 TWh/yr); C1-2023 CC_REGULAR flips to FAIL (ACCEPT-WITH-FLIP — the standing over-import residual made visible), C3a anti-favorable +4.4/+11.7/+14.5%. Pre-registered PRECHECK-caiso196-elsegundo-remap-2026-08-15.md; single delta vs caiso196_e0_control.
market_story: CC_REGULAR: the real CAISO CC fleet serves ~46-52 TWh/yr of grid demand, but El Segundo Energy Center contributes almost none of it — the plant has been largely idle since ~2019 (CEMS gross 0.05-0.19 TWh/yr, CF 2-6%), held as capacity while its energy role is taken by imports, solar+storage and the rest of the CC fleet. The prior representation had the LP running it as a ~70%-CF workhorse because only a statistical availability guess governed it; with its measured outage record in force the model now buys that energy where the market actually did — more imports and the remaining CCs — and the class total honestly shows the model's standing over-import wedge (caiso-140 §B) instead of hiding it inside one phantom plant. Hydro/PS, CHP and firm-import floors are unchanged: their stories are the caiso-188 keeper's, carried whole (see prior_keeper_note).
